title: Aira and Finale
identity: The Australian Music Centre work-version record and the composer’s own current list identify Aria and Finale for soprano saxophone and piano at about 16 minutes. Older publisher/catalog data in the assignment gives 12 minutes; the discrepancy remains unresolved. The composer describes long melodic lines in the Aria, an accompanied cadenza, and a fast coda in the Finale, with piano as a substantial partner.

evidence.claim: Work-version page identifies commissioned instrumentation, 1990 premiere and composer program note.
Composer lists Aria & Finale for soprano saxophone and piano, 16 minutes; its concerto version has a piano reduction.
Broadcast metadata credits Kyle Horch and Pamela Lidiard on an ABC Classics recording.

review_focus: Review long melodic line, cadenza-to-coda transition and piano partnership, based on composer/AMC program notes.
collection_flag: Original soprano saxophone work; professional premiere and recording are documented.
gaps: The current composer/AMC listings give approximately 16 minutes; older catalog data gives 12. The duration basis and edition relationship remain unclear.
